verdict.rationale: Crossplane is a Kubernetes control-plane framework, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only says its declarative APIs can be consumed by 'AI agents' and 'AI systems'. That is a general API claim, not a documented MCP server, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
